target_basis: Phase 5C.3 frozen design specification section 5 already permits the 36 retained / 12 DEV / 24 TEST resource alternative.
forbidden_selection_inputs: evaluator results or historical benchmark scores

disagreement_use.allowed: annotation-quality signal for clarity and adjudicability review
disagreement_use.forbidden: ranking or selecting merely by A/B agreement, disagreement count or expected system success

stable_corpus_absence_items: May be retained with scoped corpus-wide absence audit and stable disclosure scoring; this is distinct from unresolved source interpretation.

references: existing approved exploratory DEV query-only references where applicable
prohibited_for_retained: strong near-duplicate of the same bounded task/proposition bundle
not_automatically_prohibited: different material-condition task within a single protected cluster

family_coverage.both_splits: Seek representation of all four when hard quality and whole-cluster constraints permit; report gaps explicitly.

dimension_coverage.operational_definitions: Inherited corpus-grounded definitions remain; D2 counts independent substantive aspects, D4/D5 inspect valid alternatives, D7/D8 do not use observed system behavior.
dimension_coverage.policy: Reasonable coverage with documented per-split counts, overlaps and gaps; no exact quotas at the expense of legal clarity.
dimension_coverage.D9_D10_subtypes_and_controls: Seek supported/unknown-or-unmet applicability, partial/insufficient answerability and corpus-defined controls; report feasibility without inflating labels.

D6.characterization_requires: Final query/gold/split lock and later separate blind authorization

cluster_rules.unresolved_bridge: Resolve from corpus/task semantics, conservatively group connected candidates in one split, or reserve/exclude; never split an unresolved near-duplicate bridge to hit counts.
cluster_rules.article_sharing: Permitted with disclosure; not document-held-out generalization.

selection_procedure: Hash-bind all 60 candidates and adjudication sources; use no system outcomes.
Independent C reviews candidates and records final-or-unresolved benchmark annotation and every hard gate.
Resolve contamination relations, preserve exposures and form whole scenario/proposition clusters before allocation.
Retain only eligible candidates; select by stated corpus-quality criteria and four-family/reasonable-dimension coverage, never agreement count alone.
Allocate whole clusters toward 12 DEV and 24 HOLDOUT TEST; allow only exposure-compatible assignments.
If eligible alternatives remain equally suitable, predeclare and log a deterministic opaque-ID hash tie-break seed before applying it; no reseeding after inspecting performance.
Record each inclusion/reserve/exclusion reason, cluster decision, coverage gap and issue normalization; do not inspect system outputs.
If hard gates and cluster constraints prevent the target, stop final selection certification and report the shortfall; require a later versioned size decision rather than force gold.
Lock exact query/final-gold/split hashes only after adjudication and selection checks; D6 remains unmeasured until its later separately authorized stage.
